cleaning_policy: Preserve all records. No customer identifier exists; exact signatures could be different customers, so flag the 12 repeated signatures rather than delete them.
pdays_policy: 999 is a structural never-contacted sentinel, converted to null DaysSincePrevious with an explicit PreviouslyContacted indicator. Not median-imputed.
time_scope: Month and weekday are categories across the source period. No year or exact contact date exists; no fabricated calendar trend.
interpretation: Conversion is observational, not causal campaign uplift. Duration is known after the call; it is not a valid pre-call predictor.
